ax.set(title="Cyclist deaths per 100 motorist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025",xlabel="Crash year",ylabel="Cyclist deaths per 100 motorist deaths"); ax.set_xticks(years); ax.tick_params(axis="x",rotation=45); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5)); ax.plot(years,df.motorist_minus_cyclist,marker="o",linewidth=2.4,color="#25856a"); ax.axhline(0,color="#555555",linewidth=1); ax.set(title="Annual excess of motorist over cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025",xlabel="Crash year",ylabel="Motorist deaths minus cyclist deaths (people)"); ax.set_xticks(years); ax.tick_params(axis="x",rotation=45); ax.set_ylim(bottom=0); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("out/option_3.png",dpi=180); plt.close(fig); df[["year","motorist_deaths","cyclist_deaths","motorist_minus_cyclist"]].to_csv("out/values_3.csv",index=False);
